content.text: One evening in Da Nang means one proper sit-down feast, and I'd point you to bánh tráng cuốn thịt heo (boiled pork rolled in rice paper with fresh herbs) — you wrap it yourself at the table, so dinner becomes an activity. Want me to check what's near wherever you're staying?
